name: Hero’s Journey (Monomyth)
axiom: An audience follows a protagonist who leaves, is changed, and brings something back.
trigger: Onboarding journeys, founder stories, and any change that is really someone leaving a familiar state and returning altered.

steps.text: Ordinary world: show what staying costs.
Threshold: name what must be left behind.
Ordeal: the deepest test, faced without the old tools.
Return: bring the change home where it can be seen.

antiPattern.violation: A journey with no ordinary world, so the audience never learns what the protagonist gave up and the return lands as a shrug.
antiPattern.remediation: Open on the cost of staying. The departure only means something against a life worth missing.

origin.title: The Hero with a Thousand Faces
